title: How do I precisely rotate an avatar (prop)?
content:
I'm using UE MD LiveSync. 

After transferring the animation, I imported a chair as an avatar (prop).

My goal is to have my character sit on the chair, with the chair in the precise position it is in UE to avoid garment clipping. 

The chair is rotated 90-degrees in UE, but when it imports into MD, it's obviously not rotated. 

In the MD importing options, rotation is not included. In the chair's property editor, there is no option to rotate. If I select the chair, I can't access its root location to rotate it manually, and even if I could, there is no snapping for an accurate rotation degree. 

Am I correct with these assumptions or is there a way to do this in MD? 

My workaround has been to use UE's modeling tools to reset the chair's pivot rotation and translation, but that's not ideal. 

Thanks.
content_description: This web page aims to seek clarification on the process of accurately positioning and rotating imported props in Marvelous Designer to align with Unreal Engine animations, specifically addressing challenges with chair rotation and garment clipping.
